title: Constructed Tor boundary vanishes on the quotient image
statement: For every commutative ring R, modules M,F,N and surjective q:F → N, the constructed boundary vanishes on the image of Tor₁(q,M).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-tor-kernel-boundary-naturality-of] to id_F:F -> F and q:F -> N, with middle map id_F, quotient map q, and zero kernel map. The inclusion square holds because ker(id_F)=0. Tensoring the zero kernel map gives zero, yielding the claimed vanishing.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof by naturality from the identity presentation; no sorry.

    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N) (hq : Function.Surjective q) :
